---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest an idea or enhancement for the DJAC platform
title: "[Feature]: "
labels: ["enhancement", "needs-triage"]
assignees: []
---

## Feature Description

A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see.

## Problem Statement

Describe the problem this feature would solve. Is your feature request related to a problem? Please provide a clear and concise description of what the problem is. Ex. I'm always frustrated when [...]

## Proposed Solution

Describe the solution you'd like. Be specific about:

- What the feature should do
- How it should behave
- What components or modules it would affect

## Alternative Solutions

Describe any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Scope

Indicate the scope of this feature request:

- [ ] Frontend only (UI/UX changes)
- [ ] Backend only (API, services, database)
- [ ] Full-stack (both frontend and backend)
- [ ] Infrastructure (CI/CD, deployment, DevOps)
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Other

## Priority Level

- [ ] Critical — Blocks core functionality or user workflows
- [ ] High — Important feature for a significant user segment
- [ ] Medium — Nice-to-have improvement
- [ ] Low — Future consideration

## User Impact

Describe who this feature would benefit and how:

- **User roles affected**: e.g., admin, compliance_officer, analyst, basic_user
- **Modules affected**: e.g., vendor management, compliance frameworks, risk register, billing
- **User workflows**: How would this change or improve existing workflows?

## Mockups / Designs

If applicable, add mockups, wireframes, or design concepts to help visualize the feature.

## Related Documentation

Link to any relevant documentation:

- [Architecture](../docs/architecture.md)
- [API Reference](../docs/api.md)
- [Global Platform Vision](../docs/global-platform/README.md)

## Additional Context

Add any other context, screenshots, or background information about the feature request here.

---

**Note:** Before filing a feature request, please check the existing [open issues](https://github.com/anomalyco/djac-saas/issues) and [global platform roadmap](../docs/global-platform/06-roadmap.md) to avoid duplicates.
